questions.title: Your scalp symptoms need checking
questions.text: The symptoms you've described could be caused by a scalp condition, such as eczema, psoriasis, or an infection . These conditions can also contribute to your hair loss. Please ask your GP or healthcare professional to assess your symptoms and advise you about treatment. We're unable to offer you topical hair loss treatments while these symptoms are present, as they may irritate your scalp or make the underlying condition worse.
